Switches allocations to device-local memory — changes what the EP does on every upload, and no census mechanism observes whether it was in force.
Dumps output bytes. Unobserved by the census.
Selects the packed GEMV path — a different kernel, invisible to every census line.
Quarantines freed spans. Unobserved by the census.
